Bundled third-party libraries, unmodified apart from being imported as `.vendor.<name>`.

| Library | Version | License | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| [python-mpv](https://github.com/jaseg/python-mpv) | 1.0.8 | GPL-2.0-or-later or LGPL-2.1-or-later, at your option (Ankime uses it under the LGPL) | `mpv.py`, `LICENSE.python-mpv.GPL`, `LICENSE.python-mpv.LGPL` |
| [pysubs2](https://github.com/tkarabela/pysubs2) | 1.8.1 (the last for Python 3.9: 1.9 needs 3.12) | MIT | `pysubs2/`, `pysubs2/LICENSE.txt` |

When updating one, replace its license file too.
